BiblicalUsage: Janim was a town in the hill country of Judah, named once in the allotment of the tribe. It stands in the list beside Beth-tappuah and Aphekah, one of the towns given to Judah's families.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God gave His people towns as well as promises, and Janim is part of the land He measured out for Judah.
